text.title: Growth Experiment Design Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from an idea in the backlog to a written-up experiment: write the falsifiable hypothesis, name the guardrails, score ICE with cited confidence, compute sample size and whole-week duration, configure flag assignment with a control, run the instrumentation playback, fix the stop date and gate on the SRM check, write it up within a week.

step.name: write-the-falsifiable-hypothesis
step.input: The idea as the team phrased it; the analytics event catalogue; last quarter's metric definitions.
step.action: Fill `hypothesis` in `templates/growth-experiment-design.spec.md.j2`: one `change`, one `segment`, one `primary_metric` that is a measured rate (not "engagement"), `minimum_effect_pct` above zero, and the `mechanism` clause that says which belief the test can prove wrong.
step.output: `hypothesis` block, readable as "If we [change] for [segment], then [metric] will change by at least [X percent] because [mechanism]".
step.decision-gate: No number, or a metric that is a theme: rewrite before anything else (r-hypothesis-falsifiable-with-effect-size).

step.name: name-the-guardrails
step.input: The metric tree downstream of the change: revenue or conversion, retention, performance and error rates.
step.action: List at least three `guardrails[]`, one per category (`revenue_or_conversion`, `retention`, `performance_or_error`), each with a `stop_threshold` a reviewer can read off the dashboard. Record that the ship decision is made on the primary metric and that any breach vetoes it.
step.decision-gate: A category with no metric available: instrument it or record why it cannot apply; the spec does not launch with two guardrails (r-one-primary-metric-plus-guardrails).

step.name: score-ice-before-build
step.input: The team's written ICE criteria (`ice.criteria_ref`), prior experiment log, user research, analytics.
step.action: Score `impact`, `confidence`, `ease` as integers 1-10 against the written criteria. Cite the evidence for confidence in `confidence_evidence`; without a citation, cap confidence at 3. Record `backlog_rank` and work the backlog in ICE order or log the deviation.
step.output: `ice` block; the experiment's position in the backlog.
step.decision-gate: Confidence above 3 with no evidence cited: lower it to 3 or add the citation (r-ice-scored-before-build). No build ticket is opened before this block exists.

step.name: compute-sample-size-and-duration
step.input: Baseline rate of the primary metric over the last four closed weeks; eligible daily traffic for the segment; the minimum effect from step 1.
step.action: Fill `sample_size`: `baseline_rate`, `minimum_detectable_effect_pct` equal to `hypothesis.minimum_effect_pct`, `alpha` 0.05, `power` 0.8, `required_per_variant` from a power calculator, `eligible_daily_traffic`, and `duration_weeks` = ceil(required_per_variant / (eligible_daily_traffic x smallest allocation) / 7), at least 1.
step.decision-gate: `duration_weeks` above 8: redesign (larger effect, broader segment, proxy metric) and return to step 1; the experiment does not launch as is (r-sample-size-computed-before-launch).

step.name: configure-flag-assignment-with-a-control
step.input: The feature-flag platform (LaunchDarkly, Statsig, Unleash, GrowthBook, Optimizely or an internal one) and its hashing options.
step.action: Fill `assignment`: `platform`, `design` randomised_controlled, `hash_key` user_id or account_id (never session or device), `control_variant` receiving the unchanged experience, and `allocation[]` percentages summing to 100. Configure the flag exactly as recorded.
step.output: `assignment` block and the matching flag configuration.
step.decision-gate: The proposed design is before-and-after, an unrandomised geo split, or "all new users get the variant": it is an observation, not an experiment, and is not written up as one (r-control-group-randomised-by-flag).

step.name: run-the-instrumentation-playback
step.input: Staging or a one-percent cohort; the analytics destination; the exposure and metric event names.
step.action: Fill `instrumentation`: `exposure_event` fired when the user sees the variant (`exposure_logged_at` variant_seen), `analytics_destination`, `metric_events[]` for the primary and every guardrail. Trigger each event in each variant and confirm it lands with `experiment_id` and variant id; list them in `playback.events_verified[]`, set `playback.status` passed and `performed_on`. Move `status` to playback_passed.
step.decision-gate: Any event missing its experiment or variant id, or exposure logged at assignment: fix and replay; no ramp above the smoke-test allocation until the playback passes (r-instrumentation-playback-before-ramp).

step.name: fix-the-stop-date-and-gate-on-srm
step.input: `sample_size.duration_weeks`; the launch date; the platform's assignment counts at the stop date.
step.action: Fill `schedule`: `launch_date`, `stop_date` at least `duration_weeks` whole weeks later, `sequential_method` null unless a sequential test is declared now. Set `status` running at launch and do not read results before `stop_date`. At the stop date record `srm_check` (chi-square p of observed versus planned allocation; below 0.001 fails the run) and set `status` stopped.
step.decision-gate: SRM check failed: the run is invalid, no metric is read, the experiment returns to step 6 (r-fixed-stop-date-no-peeking-srm-check).

step.name: write-it-up-and-validate
step.input: The stopped experiment's primary metric with its confidence interval, guardrail readings, SRM p.
step.action: Within seven days of `stop_date` fill `write_up`: `date`, `log_entry` in the shared experiment log, `decision` (ship, iterate, kill; never ship on a breached guardrail), `primary_effect` with `observed_pct`, `ci_low_pct`, `ci_high_pct`, `guardrail_results[]` for every guardrail, `srm_p`, and one sentence in `belief_changed`. Set `status` written_up and `counts_toward_velocity` true. Run `scripts/validate-growth-experiment-design.py --file` on the spec.
step.output: Validated spec; the experiment counts toward the quarterly velocity target.
step.decision-gate: No write-up within the week, including for losers and inconclusive runs: `counts_toward_velocity` stays false (r-write-up-every-experiment).

list.item: Spec validates via `scripts/validate-growth-experiment-design.py` with no violation.
One primary metric with a numeric minimum effect, three guardrail categories with stop thresholds, ICE with cited confidence.
Duration in whole weeks between one and eight, derived from the recorded sample size and traffic; stop date fixed before launch; SRM check recorded before any result is read.
Write-up in the shared log within seven days of the stop date, whatever the decision.
